title: Disgorgement and defendant’s gains
summary: Disgorgement asks about gains attributable to the wrong rather than solely about the injured party’s loss.
notes: The text presents it alongside expectation, reliance, and restitutionary interests. Naval Institute limits the attempt to turn a licensee’s breach into a copyright-profits recovery. The hypothetical possibility of a more profitable alternative use does not itself transfer all those profits to the original promisee. The legal basis for gain recovery must be identified before selecting a defendant-profit number.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 20–26. Open assigned page 20.
